about: The landing page's Recently Added list, newest first; the page shows the first four. Add an entry whenever a batch gives players something new to find: a dungeon, a mode, a family of items, a system. Every GREENSHORE_STORY_VERSION from firstTrackedRulesVersion on must be named here, by an entry's rulesVersion or in notNews (a bump players would not call news). spacetimedb/test/landing_news.test.ts holds that. Write it the way a player would say it.

entries.title: Refine tier four
entries.text: Orichalcum Ore, Darkwood Logs and Lotus Leaves now refine into Orichalcum Ingots, Darkwood Planks and Lotus Cloth at level 50. The Master Refinery can also transmute tier-three materials into tier four, for Scrap. Four new Skills help you find more: Master Woodcutter, Master Miner and Master Farmer, and Veteran Gatherer, which grows with your level.

entries.title: Tier four on the Farm
entries.text: At level 50 you can build Mines, Trees and Plants to level 4. Each one grows a new, very rare material on the Farm: purple Orichalcum Ore, black Darkwood Logs and light purple Lotus Leaves. Start stockpiling them now. Refining, new skills and new gear made from them are coming.

entries.title: Freezes get reported
entries.text: If the game freezes or crashes, it now sends a report the next time you log in, so it can be fixed. The report says where you were and how the game was running. It never includes your password or email. You can turn it off in Settings, under Performance. In the desktop client, a frozen game also offers to reload instead of making you close it.

entries.title: Enhanced finds
entries.text: A Masterwork Vault can now hold a piece of starter gear that already carries a Forge roll. So can the Garbage Man's vault for beating his ten waves, and every wave you beat from wave ten on. It is grade I or II, and yours to reroll at the Forge.

entries.title: Enhanced gear is worth more
entries.text: An enhanced piece now salvages for more Scrap and sells to a shop for more Gold than a plain one: the higher its grade and the better its roll, the more. A top Bandit Blade sells for 165 Gold instead of 75. It is never more than the Scrap you put into rolling it.

entries.title: Forge rolls have grades
entries.text: Every Scrap Forge roll now lands on a grade, I to IV, and the piece shows it: Vampiric III, Keen IV. The star on the piece is its grade's colour, green, blue, purple or gold. Better gear rolls higher grades more often, and only gear from level 30 can reach IV. Pieces you already have moved up to the next grade, so none got worse.

entries.title: Twenty-seven new Forge rolls
entries.text: The Scrap Forge can now roll effects for every kind of gear: a weapon that staggers, an armour that hits back, a helmet that heals at Dark checkpoints, a ring that hits harder until you are touched, and many more. They work in duels at half strength.

entries.title: Forge rolls that pay
entries.text: Six new Scrap Forge rolls change what a run earns. Scholar adds experience. Gilded adds coins. Scavenger's finds Scrap on kills. Gambler's Charm can make a kill drop its loot twice, and Fortune does the same for champions. Blessed makes a chest's second reward likelier.

entries.title: New Forge rolls
entries.text: The Scrap Forge can now roll three more stat lines. Trained raises your weapon's own bonus from a helmet or necklace. Balanced adds Attack, Power and Armor at once. Reckless trades Armor for more Attack and Power. And an enhanced piece's star now shows its tier: green, blue, purple or gold.

entries.title: Composts
entries.text: Fertiliser now doubles every material a Solo Farm run gathers. Rich Compost doubles tier three, and a compost for each gathering skill makes a run mostly one material, doubled. Farm Fighter now adds 50% to every Farm material.

entries.title: Two new gathering skills
entries.text: Seasoned Gatherer raises your chance of tier-three materials on every line, and it keeps growing as you level. Signature Mastery makes a Finesse spin that strikes tier three give even more of it.

entries.title: Cheaper tier-three refining
entries.text: Ipe Planks, Adamantite Ingots and Nettle Fabric now take 25 raw materials instead of 50. Build the new Master Refinery to make them from 20, and to transmute tier-two materials into tier three for some Scrap.

entries.title: The Scrap Forge
entries.text: Build the Scrap Forge and spend Scrap to roll a modifier onto a piece of gear: more Attack, Power or Armor, or a chance to hit harder, heal, halve a hit, hurt what hits you, or heal on a kill. Enhanced gear gets a star and counts in duels too. Each roll on the same piece costs more, and the new roll replaces the old one.

entries.title: Ten challenge skins
entries.text: Ten new block skins you can't get by levelling: solid stacking cubes, glowing wireframes, candy, chrome, ice, a handheld green screen and more. Each one is earned by doing something hard, like ten Quads in one run, two Perfect Clears, or beating someone five levels above you in a duel. See what each one asks on the Skins screen.

entries.title: Treasure Seals, chest by chest
entries.text: A Treasure Seal now upgrades one chest instead of a whole run. Fill your seal slot and each of your next chests opens a tier better, one seal per chest, until the stack runs out. The chest tells you when it is sealed.

entries.title: Onslaught chests come sooner
entries.text: Once Endless turns into Onslaught, a reward chest now takes one boss fewer to reach: every second boss on your own or in Dark Greenshore, every third in co-op.

entries.title: Seals, bags and bandages
entries.text: Three new Boosts slots. Build the Sealwright to craft seals: a Warden's Seal insures your most valuable piece on the way into a Dark run or a risk duel, and a Treasure Seal makes every chest of a run one tier better. In the bag slot, a Rugged Satchel keeps the best thing you found when a Dark run kills you, and a Provisions Pouch packs one more food. And a Bandage Roll lets you stand your co-op partner up after their first fall with a single line, on full health.

entries.title: Slime Broth shields you
entries.text: Eat Slime Broth and the next attack against you is absorbed whole, a monster's or another player's. The Cookhouse's foods now heal a little less, every fish recipe needs Coal, and Minor Healing Potions cost more to brew and buy.

entries.title: The Cookhouse, the Smelter and the Trading Post
entries.text: Three new buildings for your base. The Cookhouse cooks Carrot Stew, Trout Pie and Slime Broth, foods that heal far more than a potion. The Smelter breaks spare gear down into Scrap. The Trading Post cuts the market's cut of your sales to 3% and lets you keep 30 listings up.

entries.title: Insure your gear
entries.text: Build the Warden's Vault and spend Scrap to insure one piece before a Dark run or a risk duel. Die or lose, and that piece stays with you.

entries.title: Boosts and Fertiliser
entries.text: Your equipment has a new Boosts tab, and nothing in it is lost when you die. Put Fertiliser there and every Solo Farm run gathers 15% more of everything.

entries.title: A welcome for new adventurers
entries.text: Every new account opens a Masterwork Vault, then a short tour starts you off on the Farm.

entries.title: Dark Greenshore checkpoints
entries.text: No more running out the back door. Every two rounds you reach a checkpoint: walk out with your haul, or press on and risk it all. And when more hunters are about, the next fight finds you when you least expect it.

entries.title: Sharper rotation
entries.text: The I piece now kicks off walls and turns 180 the way competitive stackers expect, and a piece on the ground can no longer be spun forever to stall.

entries.title: The Horned Staff
entries.text: Mages get a weapon to stand beside the Spiky Bow and the Kris: a staff crowned with the Cult Leader's horns.

entries.title: Boss weapons bite in PvP
entries.text: Land a Quad or a T-Spin with a Bandit Blade and the King's blade spin hits your rival's board. The Spiky Bow sends the Cult Leader's tentacle. And the Ring of Garbage now throws a slab of garbage you can see.

entries.title: Revive your co-op partner
entries.text: When your partner goes down, beat the challenge on your board to bring them back. New Mending skills heal them with S and Z spins.

entries.title: Your settings travel with you
entries.text: Log in anywhere and your handling, controls, font and skin come with you.

entries.title: Ring of Thorns
entries.text: Now hits a monster back for twice what it took, and the Garbage Man keeps your best wave.

entries.title: Jewellery
entries.text: Six idols, three amulets and three new rings.

entries.title: Feats
entries.text: Four permanent perks for the hardest deeds.

entries.title: The Ring of Garbage
entries.text: Clear big and the monster's next attack comes later.

entries.title: The Garbage Man
entries.text: A wave dungeon with its own boss.

entries.title: Co-op Endless
entries.text: Take on Endless with a friend.
